svg.text: minimal terminal runtime, rxi/lite-inspired small-core philosophy · Rust
correctness in the core; everything else is an optional layer

g.text: PTY output parsed into TerminalState, rendered from the emulated grid
keyboard input translated to terminal bytes · resize propagates both ways
--ssh TARGET and --tmux SESSION select the system-client endpoints
— compact Rust VT core — correctness lives here
terminal state/grid · primary + alternate screens · DECSTBM scroll margins
SGR · bounded scrollback · incremental UTF-8 · resize preservation
Endpoint + Surface + Command + Annotation model · capability-scoped extensions
— native PTY / ConPTY endpoint via portable-pty
raw bytes, resize, process lifecycle, exit metadata only
SshPtyEndpoint: runs your system OpenSSH client inside the native PTY
TmuxPtyEndpoint: runs your installed tmux client, attach-or-create
— trusted user Lua: shell, env, initial dimensions (not the plugin API)
optional layer — workspace behavior, shell semantics, and extension policy stay out of the compact core

svg.text: SSH transport/auth stays owned by the installed OpenSSH client · tmux server behavior stays owned by the installed tmux program
cargo build --workspace --locked · crates: terminal-core / local-pty / user-config / terminal-cli
